authorityBoundary: EveUnity owns generic Unity scene projection for provider-authored world surfaces: scene graph construction, camera/input binding, Unity package lifecycle, scene capture, and command intent emission through advertised provider command boundaries. Providers such as Aetheria own world state, assets, simulation, command authorization, receipts, and authored scenario flows. Eve keeps only the surface, command, provider advertisement, runtime capability, and conformance export contracts.
